verdict.rationale: Ollama's own site states that prompts are never tracked or trained on, and that nothing run locally ever leaves the user's machine. That is a no-training guarantee by default, which covers the core of this story. The support is a brief homepage marketing claim, not detailed policy documentation, particularly for Ollama's Cloud usage. Missing for 10: formal privacy-policy or terms documentation of the no-training commitment for cloud models, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your prompts are never tracked or trained on.
Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
so you can spend less while keeping your data private
